newsitem.title: FINLAND: MERITA PENSION FUND MAY RETURN SURPLUS.
newsitem.headline: MERITA PENSION FUND MAY RETURN SURPLUS.

text.p: Finnish banking group Merita Oy said in a statement on Friday its pension fund had been allowed to return to the group accounts surplus contributions worth 1.23 billion markka.
"The funds will be booked in the Merita group's financial accounts as extraordinary income," Merita said.
"The ministry of social affairs and health has given Merita's pension fund permission to return an accumulated surplus of 1,225 million markka," Merita said.
After the return of the excess funds, the assets at market prices of Merita's pension fund would exceed its debts and pension liabilities by about one billion markka.
